arg.name: use_hardware
arg.description: true = real ros2_control SocketCAN plugin; false = GenericSystem simulation

arg.name: use_rviz
arg.description: launch RViz; disable for headless hardware tests

arg.name: activate_arm_controller
arg.description: spawn JTC active; set false for passive encoder-only hardware checks

arg.name: encoder_timeout_us
arg.description: blocking deadline for one six-motor encoder batch before a bounded queued-frame drain

arg.name: encoder_request_window
arg.description: number of encoder requests allowed outstanding (1..6)

arg.name: encoder_request_spacing_us
arg.description: pacing between encoder requests in one window

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command 'xacro $(var urdf_path) use_hardware:=$(var use_hardware) can_interface:=$(var can_interface) can_bitrate:=$(var can_bitrate) encoder_timeout_us:=$(var encoder_timeout_us) encoder_request_window:=$(var encoder_request_window) encoder_request_spacing_us:=$(var encoder_request_spacing_us) max_speed_field:=$(var max_speed_field) min_speed_field:=$(var min_speed_field) fallback_speed_field:=$(var fallback_speed_field) acceleration_field:=$(var acceleration_field) velocity_filter_alpha:=$(var velocity_filter_alpha) max_command_step_rad:=$(var max_command_step_rad)')
